annotations.title: Remind investors of a return of capital

description: Use this when the user wants investors reminded that their share of a return of capital from one of their funds is ready to collect. Starts the reminder. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed reminders, with each investor’s addresses and anyone not reminded, for the user to confirm. This call sends nothing, and Capital Company never moves money.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their own words

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise

timeZone.description: The user’s IANA time zone, such as America/New_York
